values.note: Operator's rates page (2026): 'Nightly Stays $50-55', weekly $225-285, monthly $535-595. Its Campspot booking engine charged $55/night for the 30-amp waterfront sites and $60 for the deluxe full-hookup sites (Tue and Sat in January 2027 and a November 2026 Tuesday alike), plus a $2.50 resort fee per stay and a 3% processing fee; Campspot adds its own booking fee (3%, minimum $3).

values.note: On Campspot the RV sites take rigs of 24 to 40 ft (the 30-amp waterfront sites 27 ft) and every type is tagged back-in; about 35 RV sites were bookable on the dates read, besides water/electric and primitive tent sites.

note: On the shore of Lake Waldena near the Ocala National Forest (also 'The Retreat at Lake Waldena'). Full-hookup sites with concrete pads and fire rings; weekly/monthly rates also. Some manufactured-home lots but transient nightly RV sites confirmed. Fishing, playground.
summary: Operator site + its Campspot engine: reservable on Campspot, 50-amp full hookups, showers/laundry/store/wifi. Changed fees high 55 -> 60 (Campspot full-hookup rate) and added the $2.50 resort fee; max_rig_ft 50 -> 40 (Campspot's longest site); pull_through false (every type back-in). A mixed MH & RV community, but nightly RV sites are genuinely for sale online. Site count (104) not stated, left. Note trimmed of the site count, the wrong 50-ft length and the nightly price.
flags: Price gate (private): the operator's rates page says 'Nightly Stays $50-55', but its Campspot booking engine charged $55 (30-amp waterfront, 27 ft) to $60 (deluxe full hookup) a night for January 2027 and November 2026, plus a $2.50 resort fee per stay, 3% processing and Campspot's booking fee: over US$50 on the booking engine. Silver Springs State Park / Ocala NF are nearby if a gateway exception applies.

Waterfront re-audit lead: the entry is 'not waterfront', but the operator's Campspot listing sells 'Deluxe Waterfront RV Site' and 'Waterfront VIEW RV Site' types and says 'Experience lakefront RV camping ... claim a waterfront spot to keep the beautiful lake views right outside your door'; the home page says 'Lakefront views'.
